sourceInfo.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
sourceInfo.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sourceInfo.sourceTitle: Union Budget 2026-27, Notes on Demands for Grants
sourceInfo.note: Financial values use official Budget Estimate (BE), Revised Estimate (RE), and Actual expenditure figures from Demand No. 94. Used/remaining amounts are not shown because same-year utilization data is not available in this file.

schemesData.title: ADIP Scheme
schemesData.subtitle: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances
schemesData.description: Provides free or subsidized durable, modern, and standard aids and assistive devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, smart canes, motorized tricycles) to PwDs to promote their rehabilitation and economic independence.
schemesData.category: National Programme for Welfare of PwDs

details.benefits: 100% subsidy on aids costing up to ₹15,000 for families earning up to ₹15,000/month. 50% subsidy for income between ₹15,000 and ₹30,000/month.

schemesData.title: DDRS Scheme
schemesData.subtitle: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme
schemesData.description: Grant-in-aid support to voluntary organizations (NGOs) to establish and maintain special schools for children with hearing, visual, or intellectual disabilities, half-way homes, and early intervention centers.
schemesData.category: National Programme for Welfare of PwDs

details.benefits: Funds operational costs, professional salaries, and learning aids for special schools, early therapy centers, and community rehabilitation centers.

schemesData.title: SIPDA & Accessible India
schemesData.subtitle: Scheme for Implementation of Persons with Disabilities Act
schemesData.description: Comprehensive financial assistance for barrier-free access in buildings, public transport, websites, and government portals. Includes the Accessible India Campaign and UDID project implementation.
schemesData.category: National Programme for Welfare of PwDs

details.benefits: Funds accessibility retrofitting, tactile paths, ramp constructions, audio-signage, website compliance audits, and the UDID (Swavlamban Card) project.

schemesData.title: Scholarship for PwD Students
schemesData.subtitle: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
schemesData.description: Central scholarship program providing financial assistance to students with benchmark disabilities for pursuing pre-matric, post-matric, and professional/technical degree programs in recognized institutions.

details.benefits: Covers maintenance allowance, tuition fee reimbursement, and special allowances (like reader allowance) ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹1,50,000 per annum.

schemesData.title: Divyangjan Kaushal Yojana
schemesData.subtitle: Industry-aligned Skill Development for PwDs (New 2026-27)
schemesData.description: A new 2026-27 flagship scheme providing industry-aligned skill development and training in sectors like IT, AVGC, hospitality, and food services for Persons with Disabilities, driving dignified livelihood opportunities.

details.benefits: Subsidized skill training courses in IT, AVGC, hospitality; startup incubations; and job placement assistance linked to major industries.

schemesData.title: Divyang Sahara Yojana
schemesData.subtitle: Scale-up of Assistive Technologies via ALIMCO (New 2026-27)
schemesData.description: A new 2026-27 flagship scheme focused on providing timely access to high-quality assistive devices and supporting ALIMCO to scale up production, including establishment of Assistive Technology Marts.

details.benefits: Funds ALIMCO infrastructure upgrade, Assistive Technology Marts, and distribution of carbon-fiber limbs, active wheelchairs, and digital hearing aids.

schemesData.title: National Institutes & Autonomous Bodies
schemesData.subtitle: Project-Based Support to NIEPID, NIEPMD, SVNIRTAR, AYJNIHH, RCI, etc.
schemesData.description: Core research, therapeutic service, and rehabilitation grants for National Institutes and Autonomous Bodies including the Rehabilitation Council of India, Centre for Disability Sports, and National Trust.

details.benefits: Provides free clinical diagnostic tests, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech language pathology, research grants, disability sports infrastructure, and special education.

schemesData.title: Establishment Expenditure
schemesData.subtitle: Secretariat & Chief Commissioner for PwD (CCPD)
schemesData.description: Administrative expenditure for the DEPwD Secretariat and the Office of the Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities (CCPD).

details.benefits: Covers the administrative functioning of the Department and oversight by the CCPD.
